query: SELECT e.id, e.lessonId, l.title, e.question, e.correctAnswer FROM exercises e JOIN lessons l ON l.id = e.lessonId WHERE e.correctAnswer = 'hello' OR e.correctAnswer = 'one' OR e.correctAnswer = 'red' OR e.correctAnswer = 'mother' OR e.correctAnswer = 'breakfast' OR e.correctAnswer = 'wake up' OR e.correctAnswer = 'lion' OR e.correctAnswer = 'shirt' OR e.correctAnswer = 'sunny' OR e.correctAnswer = 'head' ORDER BY e.lessonId;
